entries.message: alif_mram_jlink: the SETOOLS install '/opt/setools' is named only by flash_args.setools_dir in the manifest, which the project controls -- tan will not EXECUTE an app-gen-toc a checkout picked for a write to a board. Name the install yourself: --setools-dir <path> on the command line or SETOOLS_DIR=<path> in the environment.

flash: helper 'cc3501e_otp' is programmed by Alp Lab in production and is customer-flashable only to recover a bricked device, with Alp Lab-supplied binaries; skipping. Field updates arrive over update_channel: alp_ota_spi_otp. To recover a bricked device deliberately, re-run with `--helper cc3501e_otp --recover`.
